versions.changelog:
call-script-coach 1.0.1 is a maintenance update with minor file and documentation changes.

- Updated SKILL.md to increment version number and remove references to the obsolete skill-card.md.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Made minor adjustments in scripts/call_coach.py (details not provided).
- No new features or functionality changes.

Initial release of Call Script Coach.

- Generates personalized, branching call scripts for high-stakes or difficult phone calls.
- Includes 10 pre-built scenarios (e.g., billing disputes, cancellations, landlord issues, collections).
- Builds objection–response trees for realistic pushback and counter-arguments.
- Produces a printable one-page cheat sheet with key lines, escalation paths, and notes field.
- Offers practice-drills mode simulating the other side and scoring your responses.
- Custom scripts support; users can specify goals, leverage, fallback, and objections.
- Includes common pitfalls, verified process checklist, and sample command recipes.
